summary: Draws the actual ray and its hit point in the Scene view, instead of guessing why a raycast missed.
overview: Draws the ray and a hit marker — a small three-axis cross plus the surface normal — colour-coded green for a hit and red for a miss. The point is to see what the raycast really did rather than reasoning about it from code.
useCases: Working out why a raycast is not hitting what you expect.
Checking a mask is excluding what you think it is.
Seeing the surface normal at a hit point while tuning alignment.

gotchas.title: Editor-only by design
gotchas.body: The drawing calls are conditional, so they compile out of a build. A visualisation you rely on in-game needs real geometry, not this.
